think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob defines any sentinel/special numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch to a different mode/disable a feature rather than acting as an ordered magnitude. 3) Determine whether any such value breaks the natural ordering by changing semantics (not just being an endpoint like 0 meaning ‘none’ in the same scale). 4) Classify as special only if such sentinel values exist; otherwise classify as regular numeric.
